verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official LanceDB command-line tool. The docs show SDK APIs (Python, TypeScript, Rust), an AI coding-agent plugin and an llms.txt file. The plugin is an adjacent agent integration, not a CLI. A database could plausibly ship a CLI, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
